The stability of the Operation Flashpoint with newer graphics cards can be significantly improved when using [[Operation Flashpoint: Startup Parameters|-nomap]] command line argument - it is very likely using this option would prevent the crash you may have just experienced.

For other troubleshooting tips you can visit [[Operation Flashpoint: Troubleshooting]].
